Batch 4H skill 1/4 (four-skill exception). Scope Operator-derived. Owns the internal-force SIGN CONVENTION itself, distinct from the computation specializations: declaring a consistent positive sense for N/V/M, interpreting a negative result as the opposite physical sense on the chosen face, the equal-and-opposite relationship between opposite cut faces, reporting SIGNED internal loadings (not bare magnitudes), and reconciling the same internal state solved from either segment. The signed specializations shear_force_internal_loading, bending_moment_internal_loading, normal_force_internal_loading own the actual V/M/N computation and are CITED as equation sources, not re-taught. Does not own diagram construction, dV/dx or dM/dx relations, stress, or deflection. Worked example Operator-re-derived (source-locked to the on-disk prompt; no inclined vector, trig cross-check N/A): SS 6 m beam, P=30 kN at 2 m, Ay=20/By=10 given; convention N+/tension, V+/upward-on-left-face, M+/sagging-CCW-on-left-face; cut at x=4 m. Left portion: SigmaFy Ay-P-V=0 -> V=-10 kN (NEGATIVE under the convention = 10 kN downward on the left face); SigmaM about the cut M-Ay(4)+P(2)=0 -> M=+20 kN·m (sagging). Two resultants shown; the negative V is the mandated at-least-one-negative result; a magnitude-only answer (V=10, M=20) is explicitly rejected as incomplete. Opposite faces equal-and-opposite: left face V=10 down/M=20 CCW pairs with right face V=10 up/M=20 CW. Right-segment reconciliation closes: By-V_rightface = 10-10 = 0 and By(2)-20 = 0 - same internal state from both segments. The distinguishing feature (the convention makes the answer signed and face/segment-consistent, not a bare magnitude) is decisive throughout. TWO-signal mapping: sign_or_placement_error at step 6 (CENTRAL - correct magnitude but wrong sense/face under the declared convention, or treating opposite-face resultants as same-sense), unclassified at step 8 (missing convention declaration, magnitude-only report, or skipped reconciliation). axis_confusion OMITTED: a convention skill with no inclined-load/component-resolution step - genuine omission, no axis assignment authored. solution_sequencing_error OMITTED: no order dependency that strands an unknown. simple_average_used omitted (Centroids-family). Opens Batch 4H.

Batch 4G skill 5/5, batch closer. Scope Operator-derived. The third member of the N/V/M trio and the axial parallel to shear_force_internal_loading: shear owns V (transverse, SigmaFy), bending_moment owns M (SigmaM about the cut), this owns N - the internal normal/axial force at a cut, from SigmaFx = 0 on the isolated portion, tension-positive / compression-negative. Same parent internal_loading_at_section, same cut-and-equilibrate method, different equation (axial) and sign convention. V and M are the siblings (cited, not solved); axial stress (N/A) and deformation out of scope. Worked example Operator-re-derived (and re-verified after a first-pass review error): inclined F=50 kN at 36.9 deg below +x on a horizontal member, so the 3-4-5 components are Fx = F cos 36.9 = 40 kN (AXIAL, along the member) and Fy = F sin 36.9 = 30 kN (transverse). Overall axial equilibrium gives Ax = -40 kN. Cut at x=1 m (before the load at 2 m); left portion carries Ax to the cut; SigmaFx = 0: Ax - N = 0 -> N = -40 kN = 40 kN COMPRESSION under the tension-positive convention. N is genuinely nonzero because the example carries a real axial load - a transverse-only beam gives N=0 vacuously; the inclined-load resolution makes N real and signed. THREE-signal mapping: axis_confusion at step 3 (the resolution step - assigning the wrong resolved component as axial, e.g. feeding Fy into SigmaFx, or swapping which component is parallel to the member), sign_or_placement_error at step 6 (the tension/compression sign under the convention and the axial-inclusion of Ax), unclassified at step 8 (report/convention boundary). axis_confusion is GENUINELY EARNED and this is the FIRST internal-forces skill to earn it - shear, bending-moment, and the relations/diagram skills had transverse-only or pre-resolved loads with no resolution step, so it was correctly omitted there four times; the inclined load here CREATES a resolution step and the axis-assignment error becomes real. Signal placed by error model, not reflex. solution_sequencing_error OMITTED: single-cut axial solve with given axial reaction, no out-of-order-strands-prerequisite step. simple_average_used omitted (Centroids-family). NOTE the axial component is F cos(36.9)=40 (cos of the smaller angle), not 30 - the resolution is unambiguous from the stated 36.9-deg geometry. CLOSES Batch 4G: skills 45-49 = bending_moment_internal_loading, shear_moment_load_relationships, shear_moment_diagram_construction, maximum_moment_from_zero_shear, normal_force_internal_loading.

signed_procedure_worked_example.prompt: A 6 m horizontal beam is pinned at A (left end) and supported by a roller at B (right end). A 10 kN downward point load acts 2 m from A, and a 20 kN downward point load acts 5 m from A. Support reactions are A_x = 0 kN, A_y = 10 kN (upward), and B_y = 20 kN (upward). Find the internal normal force N, shear force V, and bending moment M at the section 1 m from A.
solution_steps: Reactions given: A_x = 0, A_y = 10 kN up, B_y = 20 kN up.
Section of interest: x = 1 m from A (before the first point load).
Cut at x = 1 m; keep the left portion (0 to 1 m).

Left-portion FBD: A_x = 0, A_y = 10 kN up at A; at the cut face expose N (to the right), V (positive upward on the left face), M (positive CCW/sagging on the left face). No applied loads lie on the left portion.
Sign convention: N positive in tension; V positive upward on left cut face; M positive CCW on left cut face.
ΣFx = 0: N = 0 (no horizontal loads or reactions).
ΣFy = 0: A_y − V = 0 → V = 10 kN (upward on left face).
ΣM about cut = 0: M − A_y(1 m) = 0 → M = (10 kN)(1 m) = 10 kN·m (sagging positive).
Internal resultants at x = 1 m: N = 0 kN, V = 10 kN, M = 10 kN·m (per stated sign convention).

procedure_signature.notes: Batch 4H skill 1/4 (four-skill exception). Scope Operator-derived. Owns the internal-force SIGN CONVENTION itself, distinct from the computation specializations: declaring a consistent positive sense for N/V/M, interpreting a negative result as the opposite physical sense on the chosen face, the equal-and-opposite relationship between opposite cut faces, reporting SIGNED internal loadings (not bare magnitudes), and reconciling the same internal state solved from either segment. The signed specializations shear_force_internal_loading, bending_moment_internal_loading, normal_force_internal_loading own the actual V/M/N computation and are CITED as equation sources, not re-taught. Does not own diagram construction, dV/dx or dM/dx relations, stress, or deflection. Worked example Operator-re-derived (source-locked to the on-disk prompt; no inclined vector, trig cross-check N/A): SS 6 m beam, P=30 kN at 2 m, Ay=20/By=10 given; convention N+/tension, V+/upward-on-left-face, M+/sagging-CCW-on-left-face; cut at x=4 m. Left portion: SigmaFy Ay-P-V=0 -> V=-10 kN (NEGATIVE under the convention = 10 kN downward on the left face); SigmaM about the cut M-Ay(4)+P(2)=0 -> M=+20 kN·m (sagging). Two resultants shown; the negative V is the mandated at-least-one-negative result; a magnitude-only answer (V=10, M=20) is explicitly rejected as incomplete. Opposite faces equal-and-opposite: left face V=10 down/M=20 CCW pairs with right face V=10 up/M=20 CW. Right-segment reconciliation closes: By-V_rightface = 10-10 = 0 and By(2)-20 = 0 - same internal state from both segments. The distinguishing feature (the convention makes the answer signed and face/segment-consistent, not a bare magnitude) is decisive throughout. TWO-signal mapping: sign_or_placement_error at step 6 (CENTRAL - correct magnitude but wrong sense/face under the declared convention, or treating opposite-face resultants as same-sense), unclassified at step 8 (missing convention declaration, magnitude-only report, or skipped reconciliation). axis_confusion OMITTED: a convention skill with no inclined-load/component-resolution step - genuine omission, no axis assignment authored. solution_sequencing_error OMITTED: no order dependency that strands an unknown. simple_average_used omitted (Centroids-family). Opens Batch 4H.

signed_procedure_worked_example.prompt: A 6 m horizontal beam is pinned at A (left end) and supported by a roller at B (right end). A single downward point load P = 30 kN acts 2 m from A. Support reactions from beam_reactions are Ay = 20 kN upward and By = 10 kN upward (Ax = 0). Declare the internal-force sign convention N positive in tension, V positive upward on the left face of the cut, and M positive for sagging (CCW on the left face). At the section 4 m from A, find the signed internal shear V and bending moment M, interpret any negative value under the convention, show that the opposite cut faces carry equal-and-opposite action pairs, and reconcile the same internal state from the right segment. Do not find N as a primary unknown (here N = 0), do not construct diagrams, and do not report bare magnitudes without signs.
solution_steps: Reactions given: Ay = 20 kN up, By = 10 kN up. Section: x = 4 m (after P at 2 m).
Declared convention: N > 0 in tension; V > 0 upward on the left face; M > 0 sagging / CCW on the left face. Opposite faces: equal magnitude, opposite sense.
Cut at x = 4 m. First solve — LEFT portion (0 to 4 m): FBD has Ay = 20 kN up at A, P = 30 kN down at 2 m; at the cut expose V positive upward and M positive CCW.
Left ΣFy = 0: Ay − P − V = 0 → 20 − 30 − V = 0 → V = −10 kN. Under the convention, V = −10 kN means 10 kN DOWNWARD on the left face (opposite the positive upward sense).
Left ΣM about the cut (CCW+): M − Ay(4 m) + P(2 m) = 0 → M − 80 + 60 = 0 → M = +20 kN·m (sagging on the left face).
Opposite-face reading: left face carries V = 10 kN down and M = 20 kN·m CCW. Action-reaction requires the right face to carry V = 10 kN up and M = 20 kN·m CW — equal and opposite.

Reconcile — RIGHT portion (4 to 6 m): FBD has By = 10 kN up only. Right-face positive senses matching the convention's left-face rules via action-reaction: shear on the right face that is upward is the partner of left-face downward shear. Right ΣFy: By − 10 kN = 10 − 10 = 0 → confirms |V| = 10 kN with opposite face sense. Right ΣM about cut: By(2 m) − 20 = 20 − 20 = 0 → confirms |M| = 20 kN·m with opposite face sense. Same internal state from both segments.

Report (signed, convention stated): at x = 4 m, V = −10 kN and M = +20 kN·m. A magnitude-only answer such as "V = 10 kN, M = 20 kN·m" is incomplete — it omits sense and fails the opposite-face / two-segment check.

procedure_signature.notes: Batch 4G skill 5/5, batch closer. Scope Operator-derived. The third member of the N/V/M trio and the axial parallel to shear_force_internal_loading: shear owns V (transverse, SigmaFy), bending_moment owns M (SigmaM about the cut), this owns N - the internal normal/axial force at a cut, from SigmaFx = 0 on the isolated portion, tension-positive / compression-negative. Overall axial equilibrium gives Ax = -40 kN. Cut at x=1 m (before the load at 2 m); left portion carries Ax to the cut; SigmaFx = 0: Ax - N = 0 -> N = -40 kN = 40 kN COMPRESSION under the tension-positive convention. N is genuinely nonzero because the example carries a real axial load - a transverse-only beam gives N=0 vacuously; the inclined-load resolution makes N real and signed. Signal placed by error model, not reflex. solution_sequencing_error OMITTED: single-cut axial solve with given axial reaction, no out-of-order-strands-prerequisite step. simple_average_used omitted (Centroids-family). NOTE the axial component is F cos(36.9)=40 (cos of the smaller angle), not 30 - the resolution is unambiguous from the stated 36.9-deg geometry. signed_procedure_worked_example.prompt: A 6 m horizontal beam is pinned at A (left end) and supported by a roller at B (right end). An inclined point load F = 50 kN acts at 2 m from A, directed 36.9° below the positive x-axis (to the right and downward), so its components are the 3-4-5 values Fx = 40 kN (axial, to the right) and Fy = 30 kN (transverse, downward). Overall equilibrium gives Ax = −40 kN (40 kN to the left). Using the sign convention that N is positive in tension, find the internal normal force N at the section 1 m from A. Do not find the shear force or bending moment.
solution_steps: Reactions / axial input given: Ax = −40 kN. Section of interest: x = 1 m from A (before the inclined load at 2 m), so the axial reaction Ax lies between A and the cut.
Sign convention: N positive in tension, negative in compression. On the left face of the cut, positive N is drawn pointing away from the cut (to the left).

Resolve F: θ = 36.9° below +x → Fx = F cos θ = 40 kN (axial, parallel to the beam) and Fy = F sin θ = 30 kN (transverse). Only Fx would enter ΣFx if the load were on the chosen portion; here the cut is before the load, so Fx is not on the left portion. Fy never enters the N equation.
Cut at x = 1 m; keep the left portion (0 to 1 m). Left-portion FBD (axial): Ax = −40 kN at A; at the cut expose N positive (tension) to the left. No applied Fx lies on this portion.
ΣFx = 0 on the left portion (+x to the right): Ax − N = 0 with Ax = −40 → −40 − N = 0 → N = −40 kN.
Interpretation: N = −40 kN means 40 kN compression under the stated convention. (Forgetting Ax on the left portion would give the wrong N = 0; the axial-inclusion rule bites.)
Report: N = −40 kN (compression) at x = 1 m. Stop — do not solve V or M.

signed_procedure_worked_example.answer: T = +75 N·m (positive by RHR with thumb along +x)
signed_procedure_worked_example.prompt: A straight shaft lies along the x-axis from A at x = 0 to C at x = 4 m. Three applied torques act about the shaft axis (already resolved about the longitudinal axis — no transverse components): TA = +120 N·m at A (x = 0), TB = −45 N·m at B (x = 2.5 m), and TC = −75 N·m at C (x = 4 m), where positive is by the right-hand rule with the thumb along +x. Overall axial-torque equilibrium holds: 120 − 45 − 75 = 0. Using the same RHR (+x) sign convention for internal torque T, find the internal torque T at the section x = 3 m (after A and B, before C). Do not find N, V, or M. Do not convert T into stress, member rotation, section torsional constants, or rotational power.
solution_steps: Shaft along +x from A (0) to C (4 m). Applied axial torques: TA = +120 N·m at x = 0, TB = −45 N·m at x = 2.5 m, TC = −75 N·m at x = 4 m. Section of interest: x = 3 m (after TA and TB; before TC).

Confirm axis: TA, TB, and TC are about the LONGITUDINAL shaft axis. They enter ΣM_axis for T. A transverse couple about a cross-axis would be a bending moment M (owned by bending_moment_internal_loading) and would NOT enter ΣM_axis here.
Sign convention: T positive by RHR with thumb along +x. Applied torques already use that sign.

Cut at x = 3 m; keep the LEFT portion (0 to 3 m). Left-portion FBD: TA = +120 N·m at A; TB = −45 N·m at B; at the cut expose T positive (RHR +x). Both TA and TB lie between A and the cut, so both must be included. Net applied on the left portion is 120 − 45 = 75 N·m (nonzero — the two torques do not cancel before the cut).
ΣM_x = 0 on the left portion: TA + TB − T = 0 → 120 + (−45) − T = 0 → T = 75 N·m.
Interpretation: T = +75 N·m under the stated RHR (+x) convention (not a bare magnitude). Forgetting TB would wrongly give T = 120 N·m — the inclusion rule bites.

Optional right-portion check: forces/torques on 3 to 4 m are TC = −75 N·m only. Action-reaction requires equal magnitude and opposite sense on the opposite face: left T = +75 pairs with 75 N·m opposite on the right face. Right ΣM_x closes: the partner balances TC. Consistent.
Report: T = +75 N·m at x = 3 m (positive by RHR with thumb along +x). Stop — no stress, member rotation, section constants, or rotational power.
